name: Utah Valley Favorites 2024

venue.name: Veteran's Memorial Building
venue.address: 386 North Main Street, Spanish Fork, Utah

information:
# **Competitors may only register for a maximum of 2 events.**
For more information about the format of this competition, view the [format explanation tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahValleyFavorites2024#41908-format-explanation).

***This Competition will happen right after [CubingUSA Rocky Mountain FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RockyMountainFMCChampionship2024)***

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

Go to our link tree to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
